en.archTitle: Engineered for High-Throughput Inference, Zero Data Leakage, and Seamless Scale.
en.archSub: Built on multi-model LLM routing, isolated tenant data boundaries, and event-driven webhooks. Built for Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Vertex AI, and high-performance serverless runtimes.
en.archP1Desc: Dual-routed inference between Google Gemini 2.0 Flash (sub-800ms triage) and Azure OpenAI GPT-4o (complex clinical reasoning). Automatic fallback and local context caching.
en.archP2Desc: Whisper Large-v3 and Gemini Multimodal audio pipelines transcribing staff voice notes and client calls. Native Uzbek & Russian dialect processing with clinical action synthesis.
en.archP3Desc: PostgreSQL with strict Row-Level Security (RLS) and pgvector semantic indexing. Patient records and proprietary business data are fully encrypted (AES-256) and never used to train LLMs.
en.archP4Desc: Asynchronous event bus orchestrating instantaneous cross-agent handoffs (Ailo → Bandla → ILDAM). Open bidirectional webhooks for Telegram Mini Apps, Click, Payme, 1C, and Modme.

en.faqQ1: How do the 5 engines (Ailo, ILDAM, Bandla, Mirzo, Izlai) work together?
en.faqA1: They form one continuous loop: Izlai discovers and prospects accounts, Ailo engages incoming inquiries in 8 seconds, ILDAM tracks the relationship and payment milestones, Bandla locks calendar appointments, and Mirzo records meeting action items without bots. Data flows between them seamlessly so no human enters data twice.
en.faqQ2: How does Mirzo record meetings without a bot joining the call?
en.faqA2: Unlike ordinary AI notetakers that force an awkward "Bot Assistant" into your Zoom or Google Meet room, Mirzo operates with zero-bot presence. Audio is processed via private executive audio streams or post-call recordings, delivering structured action items directly to your Telegram or ILDAM CRM in 60 seconds with 100% confidentiality.
en.faqQ3: Can Bandla integrate with our existing calendars and prevent double-booking?
en.faqA3: Yes. Bandla connects directly with Google Calendar, Outlook, and your internal staff shifts. When Ailo qualifies a patient or client, Bandla checks real-time availability and confirms the slot. It automatically sends reminder alerts to slash no-shows.
en.faqQ4: How is our customer database and operational data protected?
en.faqA4: All infrastructure runs on your dedicated cloud accounts or private enterprise servers. We avoid unverified third-party scrapers: we use official Meta Graph APIs, end-to-end encrypted databases, and strict access controls. Your client data remains 100% your enterprise property.
en.faqQ5: How long does deployment and team onboarding take?
en.faqA5: Core deployment installs within 48 hours to 5 business days. Following setup, we run live interactive team training sessions, deliver step-by-step video manuals, and provide dedicated monitoring during the initial 14-day operational ramp.

uz.faqQ1: 5 ta dvigatel (Ailo, ILDAM, Bandla, Mirzo, Izlai) bir-biri bilan qanday ishlaydi?
uz.faqA1: Ular yagona uzluksiz zanjir hosil qiladi: Izlai maqsadli mijozlarni topadi, Ailo kiruvchi murojaatlarga 8 soniyada javob beradi, ILDAM mijozlar tarixi va to'lovlarni nazorat qiladi, Bandla taqvim bo'yicha qabulga yozadi, Mirzo esa uchrashuvlarni botlarsiz qayd etadi. Ma'lumotlar avtomatik uzatiladi, qo'lda ko'chirish shart emas.
uz.faqQ2: Mirzo uchrashuvlarni suhbatga bot kirmasdan qanday yozib oladi?
uz.faqA2: Oddiy ilovalardek ekranda begona bot-avatar ko'rinmaydi. Audio oqimi maxfiy kanal orqali yoki qo'ng'iroqdan so'ng xavfsiz qayta ishlanadi va 60 soniyada vazifalar bayonnomasi Telegramga hamda ILDAM CRMga yetkaziladi. 100% maxfiylik ta'minlanadi.
uz.faqQ3: Bandla mavjud taqvimlarimiz bilan bog'lanib, bir vaqtga ikki kishi tushib qolishini oldini oladimi?
uz.faqA3: Ha, albatta. Bandla to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Google Calendar, Outlook va ichki navbatchilik jadvallari bilan bog'lanadi. Ailo bemor yoki mijoz bilan muloqot qilganda faqat real bo'sh vaqtlarni taklif qiladi va avtomatik eslatmalar bilan qatnashuvni ta'minlaydi.
uz.faqQ4: Ma'lumotlarimiz va mijozlar bazasi xavfsizligi qanday ta'minlanadi?
uz.faqA4: Barcha infratuzilma sizning korporativ serverlaringiz yoki rasmiy bulutli hisobingizga ulanadi. Biz uchinchi tomon shubhali botlaridan foydalanmaymiz: Meta rasmiy Graph API, shifrlangan ma'lumotlar bazasi va Meet uchun Zero-Bot maxfiy protokoli ishlatiladi.
uz.faqQ5: Tizimni o'rnatish va jamoani o'rgatish qancha vaqt oladi?
uz.faqA5: Standart o'zak o'rnatilishi 48 soatdan 5 ish kunigacha davom etadi. Shundan so'ng biz jamoangiz bilan jonli onboarding darslari o'tkazamiz, qadam-baqadam video qo'llanmalarni topshiramiz va dastlabki 14 kun davomida to'liq nazoratda ushlab turamiz.
